thread:
ella: hit a weird parity issue during onboarding: js sdk (fncall + JSON_MODE) is turning explicit nulls inside array objects into missing keys, causing zod strict schemas to fail. python sample preserves nulls.

noah: can you paste a tiny raw vs received example?

ella: raw model output (json-mode):
```json
{"payload":[{"id":1,"note":null},{"id":2,"note":"ok"}]}
```
what landed in the handler after sdk sanitizer: 
```json
{"payload":[{"id":1},{"id":2,"note":"ok"}]}
```

rachel: that explains the zod error "required property 'note' missing" for the first element. which sdk version?

ella: js-sdk 0.11.1, using the function-call helper path and the built-in sanitizer. python sample app unchanged.

noah: hmm, sanitizer probably strips null to reduce surface area for downstream code, but we should preserve explicit nulls from jsonMode responses. Also I saw a case where a retry path ran sanitizer twice and the second pass coerced null->undefined->delete. Maybe auth/retry wrapper calls normalize on both request and response in some flows.

ella: repro steps in sample-app branch: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/gh-420-preserve-null-repro with a minimal test.

devx-bot: CI queued for branch gh-420 (job 90211)

rachel: proposed fix: change sanitizer behavior in jsonMode to treat explicit null as a valid JSON value and preserve it. add idempotency so multiple sanitize passes don't mutate further. Also add a unit test that runs sanitize twice to ensure stability.

noah: + telemetry please: emit "sanitizer.preserve_nulls" when we see nulls preserved and "sanitizer.null_stripped" when we strip. include sdk_version and json_mode bool. helps decide if we need opt-in.

ella: I prefer flipping behavior only in jsonMode. For backward compat, we can gate stricter preservation behind PRESERVE_NULLS_IN_JSONMODE=true for now and enable in demo env. If telemetry shows low breakage, we can make it default in the next minor.

rachel: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/723 - preserves nulls in jsonMode, adds idempotent sanitize, unit tests, and telemetry. requesting review from @noah.

eng-bot: CI started for commit 5f3a... (job 90211)

noah: quick review done. minor nit about test coverage for nested arrays and nested objects with nulls, added a comment. LGTM after tests.

eng-bot: CI passed for PR 723 :white_check_mark:. PR merged; release build queued (release/0.11.2).

ella: demo docker-compose sets PRESERVE_NULLS_IN_JSONMODE=true so onboarding won't hit this. added note in onboarding/README about the opt-in and why we preserved nulls.

noah: follow-up: run telemetry for 14 days, open issue #3409 to consider flipping default. also audit retry logic to avoid double-sanitize calls.

ella: great. thanks everyone 389
